title: 第9章 小鲤鱼你的爱好挺特别啊第10章 原女主的剧情怎么跑我身上了
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 江盼把自己死死缩在水里，温热的泉水没过她的头顶，只留下几串细微到几乎看不见的气泡。
她心脏扑通扑通跳得厉害。
【还好老娘是鱼精，水里能喘气，不然不等孙悟空动手，先自己憋死了。
可他…他分明看见了！
亚麻带！
怎么办怎么办？！
她听到水声哗啦，是孙悟空涉水走近的声音，那步伐悠闲得像是来散步，却每一步都踩得江盼心惊肉跳。
“啧，躲什么呢？”
孙悟空那清朗又带着点戏谑的声音在不远处响起，“水里那尾小红鲤，看着挺眼生啊？”
“不是我这花果山的品种吧？自己送上门来的点心？”
江盼吓得浑身一颤，嘴里的气没憋住，咕噜咕噜冒上去一串气泡。
牛魔王粗犷的声音从另一边传来，混着哗啦啦的水声：“七弟，跟谁说话呢？什么点心？你这温泉里还养了零嘴？”
“没什么，”
孙悟空的声音依旧带着笑，却莫名让江盼觉得更冷了，“可能是从哪处仙泉误入的，瞧着……挺鲜嫩。”
【鲜、鲜嫩？！
】江盼吓得眼前一黑，差点在水里翻个白眼晕过去，
【他要吃我？还叫我点心？可我只听过猴子偷桃，没听过猴子生啃鱼啊！
这混世魔王的口味这么清奇吗？！
她正慌得六神无主，周遭的水流突然微微一滞。
一股温温的、却半点挣不脱的力道裹住她，像被无形的手捧着将她从藏身的水里缓缓托了出来。
“噗哈！”
江盼猛地冒出水面，剧烈地咳嗽起来，呛得眼泪汪汪。
她惊慌失措地抬头，正好对上孙悟空那双含着戏谑笑意的琥珀色眼眸。
他就站在离她几步远的水中，金发被水汽濡湿，几缕不羁地贴在额角，更衬得面容俊朗，少年意气十足。
他手里还漫不经心地把玩着那条玄色裤衩，指尖勾着丝绸布料晃啊晃，眼神却像打量什么新奇玩具一样落在江盼身上。
而温泉的另一边，牛魔王、蛟魔王、鹏魔王等几位大圣也都被这边的动静吸引，纷纷看了过来。
看到水里突然冒出个湿漉漉、吓得小脸煞白、容貌却极其精致灵动的红衣少女，都露出了饶有兴味的神情。
“哟？还真藏着个小美人儿？”
牛魔王咧嘴一笑，目光在江盼身上扫过，“七弟，你这温泉还金屋藏娇啊？”
鹏魔王则眯了眯眼，眼神锐利：“气息纯净，非妖非仙……倒像是水族精怪？怎会闯入贤弟的洞府？”
content_en:
Jiang Pan huddled herself in the water. The warm spring water covered her head, leaving only a few strings of bubbles that were so fine that they were almost invisible.
Her heart was beating hard.
[Fortunately, I am a fish spirit and can breathe in the water, otherwise I would have suffocated myself to death before Sun Wukong could take action.
But he...he clearly saw it!
Linen belt!
What should I do? !
She heard the sound of water rushing, which was the sound of Sun Wukong wading closer. His pace was as leisurely as if he were taking a walk, but every step made Jiang Pan jump with fear.
"Tsk, what are you hiding from?"
Sun Wukong's clear and playful voice sounded not far away, "That little red carp in the water, looks very eye-catching, doesn't it?"
"It's not my Huaguoshan variety, is it? The snacks delivered to your door?"
Jiang Pan was so frightened that he couldn't hold back his breath, and a string of bubbles came out of his mouth.
The Bull Demon King's rough voice came from the other side, mixed with the sound of rushing water: "Seventh brother, who are you talking to? What kind of snacks? Do you have snacks in this hot spring?"
"Nothing,"
Sun Wukong's voice still contained a smile, but it made Jiang Pan feel even colder for some reason, "Maybe it came from some fairy spring by mistake. Look...it's quite fresh."
[Fresh, fresh and tender? !
】Jiang Pan was so frightened that his vision went dark, and he almost rolled his eyes in the water and fainted.
【He wants to eat me? And you asked me for snacks? But I have only heard of monkeys stealing peaches, but I have never heard of monkeys eating raw fish!
Does this demon king have such a unique taste? !
She was so panicked that the water around her suddenly stagnated slightly.
A warm but inescapable force wrapped around her, as if being held by invisible hands, slowly lifting her out of the water where she was hiding.
"Pooh!"
Jiang Pan suddenly emerged from the water, coughed violently, and burst into tears.
She raised her head in panic, and met Sun Wukong's amber eyes with a playful smile.
He was standing in the water a few steps away from her. His blond hair was wet with water vapor, and a few strands stuck unruly to his forehead, which made his face handsome and full of youthful spirit.
He was still playing with the black pair of pants carelessly in his hand, waving the silk fabric with his fingertips, but his eyes fell on Jiang Pan like he was looking at some novel toy.
On the other side of the hot spring, several great saints including the Bull Demon King, the Dragon Demon King, and the Peng Demon King were also attracted by the movement here and looked over one after another.
They all showed great interest when they saw a wet girl in red suddenly emerge from the water, her face turned pale with fright, but her appearance was extremely delicate and agile.
"Yo? Is there really a little beauty hiding there?"
The Bull Demon King grinned and glanced at Jiang Pan, "Seventh brother, do you still have a hot spring and a golden house to hide your beauty?"
The Peng Demon King narrowed his eyes with sharp eyes: "The aura is pure, neither a demon nor an immortal... but more like an aquatic spirit? How could he break into the wise brother's cave?"
title_en: Chapter 9 Little Carp, your hobbies are quite special. Chapter 10 Why did the plot of the original heroine happen to me?
